title: Run history table
description: List of runs for a workflow. Columns: run ID, status (RunStatusBadge), started, duration, steps completed/total. Filter by status.
definitionOfDone: Run history table on workflow detail page
Columns: run ID, status (RunStatusBadge), started, duration, steps completed/total

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/workflow/RunHistoryTable.tsx: Table component for run history. Props: workflowId. Uses useRuns(workflowId). Columns: run ID (truncated mono), status (RunStatusBadge), started (relative time), duration (formatted), steps completed/total (X/Y text). Filter dropdown above table: status (all, running, succeeded, failed). Click row navigates to /workflows/:id/runs/:runId. Pagination controls.
implementationPlan.note: Created RunHistoryTable with: status filter dropdown, paginated table (10/page), RunStatusBadge, click navigates to run detail, duration formatting, steps progress (completed/total).

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/pages/WorkflowDetailPage.tsx: Route /workflows/:id. Uses useWorkflow(id). Tabs: Overview (workflow metadata + stats), Runs (RunHistoryTable), Builder (WorkflowBuilder in edit mode). Start Run button triggers useStartRun(). Delete button with ConfirmDialog.
implementationPlan.note: Created WorkflowDetailPage with tabs (Overview/Runs/Builder), Start Run button, Delete with ConfirmDialog. Added route /workflows/:id in App.tsx.
